column_description: Unique identifier for each material.
Name of the material (if available). may be NULL.
Diffuse color of the material (RGB values). may be NULL.
Specular color of the material (RGB values). may be NULL.
Ambient color of the material (RGB values). may be NULL.
Emissive color of the material (RGB values). may be NULL.
Transparency level of the material (0.0 to 1.0). may be NULL.
Reflectivity level of the material (0.0 to 1.0). may be NULL.
Path to the bump map texture file. may be NULL.
Path to the normal map texture file. may be NULL.
Path to the displacement map texture file. may be NULL.
Roughness level of the material (0.0 to 1.0). may be NULL.
Metallic level of the material (0.0 to 1.0). may be NULL.
Anisotropy level of the material (0.0 to 1.0). may be NULL.
Index of refraction (IOR) of the material. may be NULL.
Version of the material. may be NULL.
Creation date and time of the material. may be NULL.
Last update date and time of the material. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the material. may be NULL.
ID of the user who last updated the material. may be NULL.
